measurements.name: Baffin Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Author regional summary; no midpoint, pooled regional interval, numerical uncertainty, confidence interval or annual extrema inferred.
measurements.geographic_scope: Near-surface flow east of Devon Island; offshore center position is a separate quantity.
measurements.section_orientation: Regional prose summary; reproducible paired transverse edge coordinates not extracted.
measurements.layer: Near-surface circulation; instrument depths do not establish a fixed width layer.
measurements.time_convention: Summer 1978 and 1979 study context; exact occupations for summary widths unspecified. Winter current meters do not provide winter widths.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-reported regional width; reproducible velocity cutoff and simultaneous paired edges unresolved.
measurements.source_citation: Fissel, Lemon and Birch (1982), Major Features of the Summer Near-Surface Circulation of Western Baffin Bay, 1978 and 1979, Arctic 35(1), 180-200, doi:10.14430/arctic2318.
measurements.source_locator: Summary, printed p198 / PDF19, right column; methods pp182-183 / PDF3-4; drifter sampling context p189 / PDF10.
measurements.extraction_method: Width prose transcribed from visually inspected original PDF; no map or paired boundary digitization.
measurements.source_quality_note: Original source selected pages visually inspected. Both summers had unusually severe sea ice; typical-year applicability unresolved. Full article and raw fields not reviewed.
remaining_gates: Recover compatible simultaneous edge positions and width boundary method.
